g.data-power-scope: full load, all lines active, in the highest use case the manual lists, 8 x 25GS-PON (96 W typical at 48 Vdc and 25 C, 104 W maximum at worst-case voltage, temperature and component tolerances). 2PM XGS/GPON is 93 / 104 W, XGS-PON 76 / 82, GPON 58 / 62
